<!--
This project uses a four-section ticket (the TrunkFlow fat ticket): the issue
embeds the design and a Definition of Done, so the work is understood before it
starts. Fill in all four sections. Keep each one tight.
-->

### What is this?

<!-- The feature, capability, or bug, stated precisely. Name the components
impacted and the boundaries. -->

### Why does it matter?

<!-- The problem this solves and who benefits. What it unlocks or unblocks. -->

### How to implement it?

<!-- The design decisions, not step-by-step code. For each decision: the
options considered and the preferred option with its rationale. -->

### Definition of done

<!-- A checkable, ordered task list. Include docs, tests, implementation, and
verification. -->

- [ ]
- [ ]
- [ ] Lint (`ruff check`, `ruff format --check`) and tests (`pytest`) pass.
